rows.title: Age-restricted — no purchase needed
rows.trigger: Submitting an Age-Restricted Delivery with no items to purchase
rows.copy: You've selected an Age-Restricted Delivery with no items needing to be purchased. Because most all Age-Restricted transactions require a purchase, we wanted to bring it to your attention to avoid potential complications. Please select Edit Request to return to the Request Details section OR select Submit to proceed if no items need to be purchased.
rows.flag: Confirm age-restricted flow is still current under G40 age rules.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Guardrail as a SMART DEFAULT: auto-enable Purchase-needed when Age-Restricted turns on (missing in both web prototypes); reserve the Attention modal for the reversed-toggle edge case, with a 'don't show again' opt-out. Prevents the low-auth → failed re-auth mess.
rows.notes: The modal that should pop-up here  occurs because 95+% of all age-restricted deliveries DO request a purchase. What should be happening here is when the "Slide if this delivery includes Age-Restricted Items" is activated, so is the Slide if this delivery requires a purchase needed (this needs to be fixed because i just checking in gopher-connect and gopher-request and that is not happening. This will resolve most issues we're facing with incorrect age-restricted orders. The user is then clearly reminded to enter the $ amount. IF they reverse the slide, and continues, we would pop-up the "Attention" modal letting them know that most all age restricted deliveries require a purchase. The modal would allow for a "do not show me this again" if in fact it is an edge case where purchase is truly not needed. (like Rx pick-ups and pre-paid alcohol) IF we don't not have an established modal for this, we need to build one and code how its triggered.

rows.title: Offer below category average
rows.trigger: Delivery offer set lower than the pre-set category average
rows.copy: Your offer is lower than the average accepted request for Delivery - Restaurant/Food Truck which is $##.##. You can increase the chances of finding your Gopher by raising your offer. To increase your offer, select Edit Request and scroll to the Payment Information section at the bottom of the request details. Tap Here To Learn More About Average Offer Info
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep (light) — an under-average offer hurts fill rate and wastes the user's time. A compact confirm with the average is worth it; could also be an inline warning at the amount field.
rows.newUx: A quick note on your offer

rows.title: Pick-up = drop-off address
rows.trigger: When pick-up and drop-off addresses are the same
rows.copy: It looks like your pick up and drop off addresses are the same. If you do not have a preference as to where your items are picked up, please slide the toggle bar after “Gopher can purchase from anywhere.”
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep (light) — same pickup/drop-off is a real logistics ambiguity for the Gopher. Offer the 'purchase from anywhere' toggle inline; a lightweight confirm is fine.
rows.notes:
This needs to be for delivery only. If moving, change "Pick-up = drop-off address
It looks like your pick up and drop off addresses are the same. If you do not have a preference as to where your items are picked up, please slide the toggle bar after “Gopher can purchase from anywhere.” to "Pick-up = drop-off address
It looks like your pick up and drop off addresses are the same. If this is a single location move, please slide the pick-up address toggle bar to No specific pick-up location"

rows.title: Phone number entered
rows.trigger: Phone number entered in description / special instructions
rows.copy: It looks like you've entered a phone number. For your protection and privacy, we do not allow phone numbers to be broadcast on the platform. Once your request is submitted, you will be able to text and/or call your Gopher. Please select Edit Request to remove the phone number. Thank you for your cooperation.
rows.flag: Ties to G40-35 In-App Communication Policy (contact-info detection).
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — privacy/platform-integrity (ties to G40-35). Detect the number and warn before broadcast. Could be an inline flag at the field rather than a modal.
rows.notes: Change the "Edit my request" button to "Edit my message"

rows.title: Age-restricted ID agreement
rows.trigger: Prior to submitting any Age-Restricted request
rows.copy: By submitting, you agree that you are at least 21 years old with a valid government issued ID to present to your Gopher who delivers your order. If you are not able to provide a valid ID during delivery, you will still be responsible for the cost of the items and the offer made to your Gopher. Please do not submit the request if you're unable to provide the required identification. Age-Restricted Delivery requests ALWAYS require ID to be shown IN-PERSON during drop off.
rows.flag: Includes a 'remove contactless-delivery references' sub-rule — confirm that stays.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — legal/compliance acknowledgment (21+, ID at delivery, liability). This one earns a blocking confirm.
rows.notes: This should follow the age-restricted protocol in place, identified when a user doesn't have Trustshield. Please update with that.

rows.title: Accepted Gopher no longer available
rows.trigger: Accepted Gopher backs out / becomes unavailable
rows.copy:
We're sorry the Gopher who accepted your request is no longer available.
Reason: Got a flat tire and stuck on the interstate.

If you would still like your request completed, please select Assign New Gopher and we'll resubmit immediately with the original offer and terms. If you would like to change something in the details, select Edit Details below. If you no longer want your request submitted, you can select Cancel Request.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — order disruption needing a choice (reassign / edit / cancel). Actionable and time-sensitive; a modal is right.
rows.notes: I need to see what occurs AFTER "options" is selected. Once the update is given to CC, please respond with what those option are.

rows.title: Payment not authorized after acceptance
rows.trigger: Bank declines payment after a Gopher accepts
rows.copy: Your request was accepted by a Gopher, however your bank did not authorize the payment. Please update your card with-in the next 5 minutes to avoid your request being cancelled. We will reassign your request to the Gopher who accepted if you can update your card in the next 5 minutes. If they are no longer available, we will rebroadcast your request to all available Gophers in the area immediately.
rows.flag: Related to 4961:1212 (Default card issue at submit) — payment-blocker pair; consider one shared treatment.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — money + order-critical, 5-minute window to fix the card. Must interrupt.

rows.title: Can't delete only card on file
rows.trigger: Deleting the only saved card
rows.copy: Stripe requires a card on file in order to maintain your account history. Please Add New Card and then you can delete the old one.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep (light) — prevents an account with no payment method. Could be inline validation on the delete action.

rows.title: Selected Gopher already on a job
rows.trigger: Requestor selects a Gopher already engaged in an active request
rows.copy: The Gopher you're attempting to accept is currently engaged in an active request. Only Gopher Pros can engage in more than 1 request at a time. You can message the Gopher to ask when they expect to finish or select an alternative Gopher.
rows.flag: Terminology: 'Gopher Pros' → confirm Elite vs the NEW accredited Pro tier (G40-199).
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — prevents selecting a Gopher already engaged. (Confirm 'Gopher Pro' → Elite vs new Pro, G40-199.)

rows.title: Duplicate request
rows.trigger: Submitting a duplicate request (same category already active)
rows.copy: It looks like you're submitting a duplicate request. You currently have a request for Delivery - General Errand submitted. If you do not need another request for the same category, please select Cancel Duplicate below. If you do need the additional request, please select Continue below.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — prevents an accidental duplicate order/charge. Worth a confirm.
rows.newUx: You already have this request out

rows.title: Cancel deterrent — Gophers available
rows.trigger: Requestor cancels <20 min w/ >20 Gophers (GA-307)
rows.copy: We do have several Gophers in your area and have fulfilled requests similar to the one you currently have submitted. It may just take a little more time for one to become available. If your request expires, you will not be charged. That said, if you'd still like to cancel, select Still Cancel below.
rows.flag: Legacy ref GA-307 — confirm mapping to a G40 ticket.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep ONE cancel-deterrent (light). Protects fill rate; no money risk. Merge with 5802:1346 so there's a single deterrent, not two.
rows.notes: This is a new feature. Please fully update G40-40. Share with new dev team the trigger, logic and function. This is intended to hopefully detour a cancellation from occurring in a relatively active market.

rows.title: Still broadcasting — Still Need / Cancel
rows.trigger: Requestor attempts to cancel while still broadcasting (GA-307)
rows.copy: Your request is still being broadcast in your area. It may just take a little more time for a Gopher to become available. If you select Still Need! we will immediately send another notification to local Gophers who may have missed it the 1st time. If your request expires, you will not be charged. That said, if you'd still like to cancel, select Still Cancel below.
rows.flag: Overlaps 'Cancel deterrent' (4514:1156) — pick one cancel-deterrent modal.
rows.adviceNote: ✕ Overlaps the other cancel-deterrent (4514:1156). Keep one.
rows.notes: Need thumbnail. This modal is regarding to G40-209.

rows.title: Request expired — interested workers
rows.trigger: Request expires with interested workers waiting
rows.copy: Your request has expired, however you have workers interested in helping. If you still need your request completed, please tap “View Interested Workers.” If you no longer need your request completed, please tap Cancel.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — expired-with-interest is a real decision point (view interested workers vs cancel). Actionable, keep.

rows.title: Bid sent — what happens next
rows.trigger: After a Gopher submits a bid
rows.copy: Your bid has been sent to the Requestor for approval. The Requestor can accept or decline your offer. You will be notified if your offer is accepted or declined. If you accept another offer while pending, your offer will be cancelled (unless you're a Gopher Pro). Tap the back button to return to the Request Queue.

rows.copy: Your counter offer has been sent to the Requestor for approval. The Requestor can accept or decline your offer. You will be notified if your Counter-Offer is accepted or declined. If you accept another offer while pending, your counter-offer will be cancelled (unless you're a Gopher Pro). Tap the back button to return to the Request Queue.
rows.adviceNote: ↓ Same as bid-sent — toast + inline next-steps.

rows.title: Select-My-Gopher offer sent
rows.trigger: After a Gopher accepts a Select My Gopher offer
rows.copy: Your Select My Gopher offer has been sent to the Requestor for approval. The Requestor can accept or decline your offer. You will be notified if your offer is accepted or declined. If you accept another offer while pending, your offer will be cancelled (unless you're a Gopher Pro). Tap the back button to return to the Request Queue.
rows.flag: Terminology: 'Select My Gopher' → 'I'll select my worker'.
rows.adviceNote: ↓ Same — toast + inline next-steps. (Rename 'Select My Gopher'.)

rows.title: Accepted (non-age-restricted) — next steps
rows.trigger: After a Gopher accepts a non-age-restricted Need ASAP request
rows.copy: Please message the requestor to introduce yourself. Please update the app at each relevant checkpoint. This will notify the Requestor of your progress. Once your request is completed, please rate the Requestor. You can review your completed request information on your Dashboard -> Account -> Request History -> Completed.

rows.adviceNote: ↓ Post-accept education → inline checklist on the job screen, not a modal the worker dismisses and forgets.

rows.title: Accepted (age-restricted) — next steps
rows.trigger: After a Gopher accepts an age-restricted Need ASAP request
rows.copy: Please message the requestor to introduce yourself. Please update the app at each relevant checkpoint. This will notify the requestor of your progress. Before handing off the items, ensure you've taken a picture of the ID and verified the identity of the Requestor in the app. Once your request is completed, please rate the Requestor. You can review your completed request information on your Dashboard -> Account -> Request History -> Completed.

rows.title: Complete request — outcome options
rows.trigger: Gopher completing a request (choose completion outcome)
rows.copy:
If you have purchased items and arrived to the destination, you are entitled the expected earnings of the request. Select Complete Request - No Delivery in this case. If you and the requestor have made another arrangement that involves a different price to pay you for your time, select the < Back button and make a Cost Adjustment. If you decide to cancel the request, you will not be assessed the cancellation fee.

Sub-states: 'ID and Identity Not Confirmed' reason entry; 'NO-SHOW' GPS-logged warning.
rows.flag: Complex multi-state screen (No-Delivery / ID-not-confirmed / No-Show) — likely several modals. Break out during design.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — completion outcome affects money + integrity (No-Delivery earnings, GPS-logged No-Show, ID-not-confirmed). Break the multi-state screen into distinct G40-308 states.
rows.notes: This is NOT a complete request modal. This is IF the gopher selected ID and Identity NOT CONFIRMED.

rows.title: Complete your profile (About Me)

Once the order is completed and confirmed, your payout of $89.92 will immediately be transferred to your bank account.

If your Counter-Offer is accepted, once the order is completed and confirmed, your payout of $##.## will immediately be transferred to your bank account.

rows.title: Can't complete — pending cost adjustment
rows.trigger: Gopher tries to complete with a pending Cost Adjustment
rows.copy: This request cannot be completed with a pending Cost Adjustment. Please message your Requestor and ask them to approve the Cost Adjustment. If you cancel the adjustment, you can complete the request for the original amount.

rows.title: Cost adjustment before leaving merchant
rows.trigger: Items cost more than the out-of-pocket line (Pro Shopper)
rows.copy: If you find the items to be more than entered in original out of pocket expense line, we recommend submitting the cost adjustment and waiting for the approval before leaving the merchant where the items were purchased to avoid any issues.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — 'submit the adjustment and wait for approval before leaving the merchant' prevents out-of-pocket risk. Real money guard.

rows.title: Increase cost of items — upload receipt

rows.title: Cost adjustment > 20% auth
rows.trigger: Cost Adjustment sent greater than the 20% authorization
rows.copy: The requestor is authorized for an additional $##.## with this transaction. Anything greater than $##.## will require an additional temporary authorization for the entire new amount on their end. Please do not purchase additional items until the Cost Adjustment is approved and funded. You will get a notification immediately upon the Requestor's approval. In the event the new amount fails, the transaction will resort back to the original amount.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — >20% re-auth risk; 'don't purchase until approved' prevents unfunded spend. Money-critical.

rows.title: Adjusted pay below original offer
rows.trigger: Gopher sets an earnings adjustment below the original offer
rows.copy: The Gopher Payment amount you are adjusting is less than the original offer. This amount represents your net earnings. If this is agreed upon, please select Continue. If this was a mistake, please select “Edit Adjustment.”
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — confirms a lower-than-offer earnings adjustment (worker protection). A confirm is appropriate.

rows.title: Counter-offer exceeds 150% max

rows.adviceNote: ↓ Validation (150% cap) → inline error on the counter-offer field, not a modal.

rows.title: Counter-offer accepted — credits left

rows.title: Not interested — remove from queue
rows.trigger: 'Not Interested' selected on an available request
rows.copy: This will permanently remove this request from your Available Requests queue. If the request is later updated to increase the offer, it will not be shown.
rows.adviceNote: ↓ 'Remove from queue' → use an undo toast (consumer-app norm for remove) instead of a confirm modal.

rows.title: Keep app open for location

rows.copy: Please allow the Requestor to view your route progress by staying on your Request Details screen as much as possible. If your screen goes to sleep or you switch to another app, your location information won't be available.
rows.adviceNote: ↓ 'Keep app open' → persistent inline banner on the active-request screen, not a one-time modal.

rows.title: Requestor payment issue — hold
rows.trigger: Requestor must fix payment; worker given <5 min hold / right of refusal
rows.copy: The Requestor needs to update their payment account for this request. We have given them <5 minutes to correct the issue. Once corrected and we can guarantee payout funds, the request is yours and you can proceed accordingly. If you still want this request select Continue. If you no longer want to accept this request, please select Do Not Accept. Sorry for the temporary inconvenience.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — accept-or-not decision while the requester's payment is pending; affects the worker's time/earnings.

rows.title: Request temporarily unavailable
rows.trigger: Request paused due to requestor payment auth issue
rows.copy: This request is temporarily unavailable due to a payment authorization issue. In the meantime, please select the View Available Requests button below to see available requests in your area. Once the payout issue is resolved, you will be notified and will have the 1st right of refusal to accept the order.

rows.title: Already accepted by another Gopher

rows.adviceNote: ↓ 'Already accepted' is status → inline message + redirect, not a modal.

rows.title: Multi-worker job accept
rows.trigger: Gopher accepting a job requiring multiple workers (Connect-type)
rows.copy: You are attempting to accept a job where you are responsible for # workers. The Total Pay for this job is $###.##. If you are unable to provide the needed worker headcount, please select Do Not Accept. If you are able to provide all of the workers needed and can perform the job, please tap Continue.

rows.title: Payout card blocked / compromised

rows.copy: Your bank is no longer allowing Stripe to payout to your default debit card. This typically happens when a card is blocked or compromised. IF your card is blocked, please contact your bank to resume payouts. Once unblocked, your deposit will resume the next business day. IF your card is compromised, tap Add New Debit Card. Once the new debit card is added your deposit will resume the next business day.
rows.adviceNote: 🛡 Keep — payout-card blocked/compromised resolution (money). Keep.

rows.title: Earnings range advice (>$10 deliveries)
rows.trigger: Gopher sets earnings in Work Radius & Settings above $10.00
rows.copy: If you're interested in performing Deliveries, we do not recommend setting your earnings range above $10.00. Keep in mind you can always submit a Counter-Offer for something you feel is too low. If you set your earning limit at >$10.00 and several requests are submitted at $9.00, you will not see them. (Ex: submitting a Counter-Offer for $11.00 in that situation has a very high likelihood of being accepted.)
rows.adviceNote: ↓ Earnings-range advice → inline hint on the Work-Radius/Settings screen, not a modal.
rows.notes: no longer in play, expired modal

rows.title: Need ASAP but >15 miles away

rows.copy: Because this is a Need It Now request and you are greater than 15 miles away, we have sent the requestor a message to approve. If approved, please proceed ASAP.

rows.adviceNote: ↓ '>15 miles, approval sent' is status → inline notice. (Rename 'Need It Now' → 'Need ASAP'.)

rows.title: Add a photo for confirmation
rows.trigger: Gopher completing a contactless / skilled job — photo required
rows.copy: Please add a pic so we can share with the Requestor during confirmation. If your order was for contactless delivery, this is required. If this was a skilled labor job, we will save them to your profile so future customers can see your work!

rows.title: OTP not received — help
rows.trigger: User not receiving their OTP during signup / login
rows.copy: If you're not receiving your OTP, your carrier may have identified our SMS as spam by mistake. Please text START to 919-887-7143 which will authorize our number to send you the OTP. For security reasons, we do not accept pre-paid or VOIP numbers. If you're in an area with a known outage or typical reception issues, your OTP delay may be linked to the congestion those issues cause. If none of the information above helps, please select the Contact Us button below.
rows.flag: Ties to signup / OTP flow.
rows.adviceNote: ↓ OTP help → inline expandable ('not getting your code?') under the OTP field, not a modal.
